promise.title: Our promise
promise.intro: How Chitto Mitho delivery works, in plain words.
promise.linkBody: Clear charges, private details, and what to do if something goes wrong.
promise.s1Body: We confirm the delivery charge and the expected time with you on WhatsApp before a rider is sent. No surprise charges at the door.
promise.s2Body: Cash on delivery, or QR at the door (eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay). You never pay online on this website, and we never ask for card details.
promise.s3Body: This website does not store your name, phone number or location. They are saved only on your own phone to save you typing, and your WhatsApp message is the only place they are sent.
promise.s4Body: Message us on WhatsApp as early as you can. We can usually change or cancel an order before the shop starts preparing it. Once it is being prepared or is on the way, changes may not be possible.
promise.s5Body: Wrong item, missing item or a late order? Message us on WhatsApp as soon as you notice, ideally within 24 hours, with your order details. We will look into it and do our best to put it right.
promise.s6Body: Liquor is for adults aged 18 and over. We check ID at the door and may refuse delivery without it.
promise.s7Body: Open every day, 10am – 10pm, in Dharan, Itahari, Biratnagar and nearby areas. If your area is not in the list, choose "Other area" and we will tell you if we can reach you.

about.title: About Chitto Mitho
about.story: Chitto Mitho is your everyday delivery partner in Dharan, Nepal, since 2024. We bring food from your favourite cafés and restaurants, groceries, drinks, gifts and flowers, and parcels. If you need something from anywhere, just ask.
about.areas: We deliver in Dharan and nearby areas in every direction, including Itahari and Biratnagar.
about.pay: Cash on delivery or QR at the door (eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay). We confirm the delivery charge on WhatsApp before we deliver.
